items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Dunn, Johnny Dunn was a great star then, playin' as a soloist

ctx.x: Johnny Dunn, Johnny Dunn was a great star then, playin' as a soloist, one of the first trumpet players to play the, make big - he was on big time, playin' as a soloist. He didn't sound like Louis Armstrong, you know.
